title: ThermoFuzzy-PID: physical model, control and evidence atlas

plates.title: Burn-in chamber: physical picture and reduced model
plates.caption: Illustrative cabinet, rack, heater and four named sensor channels, alongside the one-state model and allocated measurement delay. Geometry and sensor positions are not recovered hardware dimensions.

plates.title: Identification: excite, estimate, then challenge the model
plates.caption: The four source-reported FOPDT parameter sets, synthetic in-sample fitting and a recommended independent validation path. The integer-delay ARX mapping is distinguished from the FOPDT step-fit experiment; notebooks 01/05 do not execute the recommended split.

plates.title: PID implementation: gain convention, filtering and saturation
plates.caption: Parallel PID branches, derivative on measurement, actuator limits and the exact candidate/corrected-integral distinction in conditional integration and back-calculation.

plates.title: Mamdani gain scheduling: memberships, omissions and memory
plates.caption: Three 7-by-7 sparse consequent matrices read directly from the implementation, declared input memberships, mean-of-maxima inference and separate gain memory for omitted consequents.

plates.title: Robustness: paired uncertainty and a separate linear loop audit
plates.caption: Matched synthetic uncertainty experiments and a separate fixed, linear, unsaturated sensitivity/margin analysis. The two evidence domains are not interchangeable.

plates.title: Optimization: tune on training scenarios, freeze, then evaluate
plates.caption: Dense-rule extensions, gain smoothing, IMC blending and a training-only differential-evolution loop with an explicit frozen boundary before held-out evaluation.

scope: Original explanatory drawings based on the repository's audited source register and implemented equations. Source-reported parameters, reconstruction assumptions and synthetic experiments remain distinguished.
